# Vendored third-party files

Mirrored so Mod Menu Manager can download them from one place on the console.
Each keeps its own licence.

| Folder | Source | Version | Licence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `codxe/` | [michaeloliverx/codxe](https://github.com/michaeloliverx/codxe) release r351 (`codxe.xex`) and `resources/` at commit fd6e952 | r351 | MIT |
| `hayzen/` | [ClementDreptin/Hayzen](https://github.com/ClementDreptin/Hayzen) release v9.7.2 (`Hayzen.xex`) | 9.7.2 | Apache-2.0 |

`tools/build_library.py` copies the plugins into `library/packages/` and
builds the CodJumper packages from `codxe/resources/`.
